blind.description: A stylized gothic stone wall fountain featuring an arched backplate flanked by rectangular pillars, an off-white carved skull mounted in the center, and a semi-circular stone basin underneath. Greenish slime or stagnant liquid residue drips from the open jaw of the skull into the basin. The back side is finished as flat block masonry. All surfaces are clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a thick rectangular stone top with square pillar posts at each side and a central keystone, with a semi-circular hollow basin extending outward to the front.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.8 ft tall) and roughly 2.2 ft wide.

notes: Greenish slime or residue texture visible dripping from the skull jaw into the basin
